subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Review and Reference: Theme 3 learning objectives and core words test
outcomes: Check your progress on the Theme 3 learning objectives
Spell and use the 13 core words correctly

tf.why: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea.

tf.s: 'Trek' means a short, easy walk to the shop.
tf.why: A trek is a long, difficult walk.

tf.s: 'Revise' means to improve the content and organisation of your writing.
tf.why: Revising makes your ideas clearer and better organised.

tf.s: 'Proofread' and 'revise' mean exactly the same thing.
tf.why: Revise improves content; proofread checks for mistakes.

tf.s: 'Amenities' are useful facilities, like a pool and a gym in a hotel.
tf.why: Amenities make a place comfortable and useful.

tf.s: 'If you visit Oman, you should see Nizwa' is a correct first conditional.
tf.why: If + present simple, should + base verb.

tf.s: 'If it will rain, we might stay at home' is correct.
tf.why: Use the present simple after if: 'If it rains...'

tf.s: A 'canyon' is a tall building in a city.
tf.why: A canyon is a deep valley with steep sides.

tf.s: 'Destination' is the place you are travelling to.
tf.why: Your destination is the end of your journey.

boxes.why: A voyage is a sea journey.
A trek is a hard walk over a long distance.

Number of core words in Theme 3

mcq.q: What is the difference between 'revise' and 'proofread'?
o: Revise improves content and organisation; proofread checks for mistakes
Revise checks spelling; proofread adds new ideas
Both mean handing in your essay
mcq.why: They are two different stages of writing.

o: The hotel has excellent amenities, including a pool and a gym.
We walked through the amenities for five hours.
The amenities of the canyon were deep.
mcq.why: Amenities are useful facilities in a place.

mcq.q: Which word means 'go on a long, difficult walk'?
mcq.why: A trek is a long, tiring walk.

mcq.q: Which group contains only Theme 3 core words?
mcq.why: These four are on the Theme 3 core word list.

mcq.q: Write a first conditional with 'might'. Which is correct?
o: If it rains, we might stay at home.
If it might rain, we stay at home.
If it rained, we might stayed at home.
If it rains, we might to stay at home.
mcq.why: If + present simple, might + base verb.

mcq.q: Complete: 'If you ___ to the mountains, you could see the canyon.'
mcq.why: The if clause uses the present simple.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: 'Muscat is a popular tourist ___.'
mcq.why: A destination is a place people travel to.

o: If you will enjoy hiking, you might like the trek.
If you enjoy hiking, you might like the trek.
If he likes nature, he will love the canyon.
If you visit Oman, you should see Nizwa.
mcq.why: Do not use 'will' in the if clause.

mcq.q: Why do you rate your progress on the learning objectives before the test?
o: To see which skills you are confident in and which need more practice
To avoid doing the spelling test

mcq.q: Which word is the odd one out?
mcq.why: 'Proofread' is about writing; the others are about travel.
